chapter: Inside the Basie rhythm section and band family
title: The rhythm section as the band's engine; Basie sets tempos
summary: Helen Dance asks about the roles of the four; Greene says Basie set all tempos and the rest understood each other.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Well, we've got to talk about this because this rhythm section was the heart of the band, and was the band.
Mm hmm. Mm hmm.
Everything was added with it -- to it.
Right. Mm hmm. Right.
And, of course, you know -- there were changes afterwards and everything. But, nothing ever equalled this one.
Mm hmm. Mm hmm.
This was it. And, it was, -- well -- I was going to say complex personalities. I mean, alot of -- so, there was Jo. There was Basie, first of all.
Mm hmm. Mm hmm.
And, there was Jo. And, Walter was more of an easy going guy, wasn't he, or am I wrong on that?
How do you mean that?
Well, I mean, he wasn't as -- he wasn't -- was he very assertive? Walter Page. Was he a guy that asserted himself very much?
Yeah. Not exactly bossy, but with a mouth. He didn't have too much mouth did he?
No, not really. But he liked things to be right.
That's right. He'd step in and say when he -- when he wasn't happy he'd have something to say.
Yeah, yeah, yeah. Yeah. He wanted it to be right.

Well, so, what I would really like to establish, you know, for all our information -- I mean, in a sense it's like the band had an engine. All four of you were a part of it, right? And, all four of you paved your own particular road. You were -- as you said -- you kept the time going always.
Mm hmm. Mm hmm. Mm hmm.
And then, each person had their roles.
Yeah. Each one, -- they would do whatever they wanted to do.
That's right. Yeah.
They understood that -- the three of them understood each other. You know, what they were doing.
Yeah. Yeah. Well, now, what I'd like to ask you is -- my hunch is that the thing mostly that had to happen was -- mostly, I mean, it was a question -- on the whole of sending Basie,
wasn't it? I mean, the thing was for Basie to get his kicks. Right?
Right. Right.
Then I'm correct. Alright. That was the first thing, you know.
He's -- yeah, yeah.
He's looking for his kicks.
Right. Basie set whatever --
Yeah.
Whatever has to be done -- he did it, more or less.
Yeah. Yeah.
He set all the tempos. He was the force, you know. But he wasn't like -- that outspoken.
No. That's right.
We knew --
That's what I'm getting at. You knew that this was how it was.
Right. We knew.
This was how it was. Well then, Joe, to some extent, was always chafing at the bit, and ready to get away, right?
Yeah, yeah, yeah.
And, had to be held down.
Yeah. We wouldn't let him get away.
